description: Conversion of existing stable structure into a single storey outbuilding for the use as a home office and music room.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (800; 801; 802; 803; 804; 805; 806; 807; 808  Received:  08 June 2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the single storey rear outbuilding hereby approved.

Condition : 5 - The outbuilding hereby approved shall not be used for purposes other than those specified on the plans hereby approved or such uses which are incidental to the house at 19 New Road, TW8 0NX.  For the avoidance of doubt the building shall not be used as a living room, bedroom, kitchen or as a separate unit of accommodation, nor for business purposes.
